title: Witches & Warlocks Weekend takes over Port Jeff
blurb: All of Port Jefferson village turns witchy on Saturday and Sunday, October 10-11. Come in costume (if you dare) and wander the whole village: shops, restaurants and the harbor all join in.
bullets: Saturday: the Headless Horseman rides in, the Witches Quest runs all over town, and the first 100 people at Chandler Square at 11 AM get a limited-edition tote
Saturday night: a “Thriller” gathering in Chandler Square at dusk, then the Witches & Warlocks Night Market at Danfords, 7-9 PM
Sunday: the Witches Quest continues, plus a children’s book reading with author Shawn Keane at Founder’s Park, 10 AM
Extras (some ticketed): a bar crawl at 13 restaurants, haunted tiki cruises, a haunted history walk, tarot and tea leaf readings, a paddleboard rave and a costume contest
subject: 🧙 Witches & Warlocks takes over Port Jeff
short: All of Port Jeff turns witchy Saturday and Sunday. Come in costume (if you dare)!

title: Karing for Kids returns Thursday, Oct. 15
blurb: The O'Dwyer-Brainard Team's 4th annual Karing for Kids fundraiser is Thursday, October 15, 5-8 PM at Culpers 1778 in Setauket. It benefits Stony Brook Children's Hospital. Come out and support the kids.
short: Thu, Oct. 15, 5-8 PM at Culpers 1778, for Stony Brook Children's Hospital
